data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** dda616051ef1

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Missing dispatch case

#### Expected Behavior

Sprint SKILL.md testing_mode routing table should include a recipe: row that dispatches to the recipe executor (not dso:red-test-writer).

#### Actual Behavior

When sprint encounters a task with testing_mode: recipe:, it falls through to RED dispatch path, dispatching the RED test writer instead of the recipe executor. Discovered during code review of task 7b2a-e2f9 (Layer 0 story 8907-daae, epic 8d21-3aa8).

#### Trigger

Added recipe: testing_mode to implementation-plan SKILL.md in task 7b2a-e2f9 without corresponding sprint routing update. Will surface when Layer 1+ stories create recipe: typed tasks.

### 3. Fix

Add recipe: row to sprint SKILL.md testing_mode dispatch table, routing to recipe executor rather than RED test writer.
data.title: sprint-skill: no recipe: testing_mode dispatch row -> recipe: tasks fall through to RED dispatch
